# PLPBenchmarks

# Introduction

PLPBenchmarks is an R package for building benchmarks of patient-level
prediction models using data in the OMOP Common Data Model format.

The package is build on top of the PatientLevelPrediction, an R package
to develop and validate prediction models.

# Features

- Contains the necessary artifacts to reproduce and replicate the
  benchmark problems predefined in this package.
- Provides problem specifications for all problems, as well as, their
  model designs used to develop the models.
- Takes one or more model designs as generated by
  [`PatientLevelPrediction::createModelDesign()`](https://ohdsi.github.io/PatientLevelPrediction/reference/createModelDesign.html).
  Within a model design, one can specify covariate settings, algorithms,
  inclusion criteria for the target cohort etc.
- Extracts the necessary data from a database in OMOP Common Data Model.
- Includes functions to explore model performance.
- Includes a shiny app to interactively view and explore results.

# Screenshots

A shiny app containing benchmarks developed with LASSO can be found
here:

[PLPBenchmarks
Results](https://results.ohdsi.org/app/27_PlpBenchmarkResults)

# Technology

PLPBenchmarks is an R package.

# System Requirements

Requires R (version 3.3 or higher). Installation on Windows requires
[RTools](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/).
PatientLevelPrediction use libraries that require Java and Python. See
the [PatientLevelPrediction package’s installation
guide](https://github.com/OHDSI/PatientLevelPrediction/blob/main/README.md#getting-started)

# Getting Started

- To install the package call
  `remotes::install_github("mi-erasmusmc/PLPBenchmarks")` or fork or
  clone the package.

Package function reference:
[Reference](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/index.html)

# User Documentation

Documentation can be found on the [package
website](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/).

# Package index

### View tasks

View pre-specified tasks for real-world data mapped to the OMOP-CDM and
the Eunomia dataset.

- [`tasks`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/tasks.md)
  : tasks
- [`modelDesigns`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/modelDesigns.md)
  : modelDesigns
- [`eunomiaTasks`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/eunomiaTasks.md)
  : eunomiaTasks
- [`eunomiaDesigns`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/eunomiaDesigns.md)
  : eunomiaDesigns

### Create a benchmark design

Create a benchmark design and inspect it.

- [`createBenchmarkDesign()`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/createBenchmarkDesign.md)
  : Create a benchmark analysis design
- [`viewBenchmarkSettings()`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/viewBenchmarkSettings.md)
  : View settings of a benchmark design

### Create cohorts, extract data

Create cohorts on an OMOP-CDM instance and extract data from the CDM.

- [`createBenchmarkCohorts()`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/createBenchmarkCohorts.md)
  : Instantiates a set of cohorts
- [`extractBenchmarkData()`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/extractBenchmarkData.md)
  : Extract the data for the benchmark

### Run a benchmark

Run the benchmark design and view results.

- [`runBenchmarkDesign()`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/runBenchmarkDesign.md)
  : Run the benchmark models.
- [`getBenchmarkModelPerformance()`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/getBenchmarkModelPerformance.md)
  : Get the mode performance.
- [`viewBenchmarkResults()`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/viewBenchmarkResults.md)
  : View a shiny app with the benchmark results

### Other functions

Other functions used to offer some extra functionalities but will soon
be deprecated.

- [`createSampleTrainSetSettings()`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/createSampleTrainSetSettings.md)
  : Create sample settings to sample the train set.
- [`viewBenchmarkTasks()`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/viewBenchmarkTasks.md)
  : View the benchmark tasks
- [`loadModelDesigns()`](https://mi-erasmusmc.github.io/PlpBenchmarks/reference/loadModelDesigns.md)
  : Loads the model design list
